Lawn Care for Commercial
Property Managers

Make a great first impression on your clients and customers.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section][et_pb_section fb_built=”1″ use_custom_gutter=”on” gutter_width=”2″ specialty=”on” _builder_version=”4.9.0″ _module_preset=”default” width=”100%” max_width=”100%” inner_width=”90%” inner_width_tablet=”” inner_width_phone=”80%” inner_width_last_edited=”on|phone” inner_max_width=”100%” custom_padding=”37px||40px|||” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_column type=”1_2″ _builder_version=”3.25″ custom_padding=”|||” global_colors_info=”{}” custom_padding__hover=”|||”][et_pb_text ul_type=”square” ul_position=”inside” ul_item_indent=”7px” _builder_version=”4.11.3″ _module_preset=”default” text_font_size=”17px” link_text_color=”#00B140″ custom_margin=”-7px|||||” custom_padding=”|||0px||” global_colors_info=”{}”]

A healthy, well-groomed lawn is important to your business image and important to your bottom line. That’s because a positive first impression can dramatically impact sales, occupancy rates, employee morale and, perhaps, your net operating income.

Here’s what TruGreen® can do for your company’s landscape:

  • Guaranteed results and superior service
  • Provide a dedicated Business Development Representative
  • Develop tailored program recommendations
  • Offer professional grounds consultation services
  • Perform plant and soil diagnostics
  • Local, regional and national service capabilities available
  • Supply conscientious follow-up action and periodic progress reports

And it’s all backed by the TruGreen Healthy Lawn Guarantee®

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text disabled_on=”on|on|on” _builder_version=”4.9.0″ _module_preset=”default” text_text_color=”#E07A0D” text_font_size=”21px” link_font=”|700|||||||” link_text_color=”#7CDA24″ link_font_size=”17px” custom_margin=”||15px|||” text_font_size_tablet=”” text_font_size_phone=”” text_font_size_last_edited=”on|desktop” link_font_size_tablet=”” link_font_size_phone=”” link_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” disabled=”on” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”]

Contact us at one of our nearby locations to get your commercial services started today!

Locations
– Alexandria
– Shreveport
– Lafayette
– Lake Charles
– Corpus Christi
